author: Traditionally James, the brother of Jesus
authorNote: Some scholars think it was written later by someone in James's name.
audience: "The twelve tribes of the Dispersion": Jewish Christians
overview: James is full of practical wisdom. Be doers of the word, not only hearers. Control your tongue. Do not favour the rich. Faith that does nothing is dead.
storyPlace: The first of the "general letters" written to the wider church.
